notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes: Minor update to fix some minor glitches. One involving an area where the player can get stuck.

notes.title: Major Patch!
notes.notes:
This patch includes additional play modes and improved character sprites. There are also a variety of bug fixes to improve the overall stability and experience of the game.

List of Improvements


 Platformer mode - allows you to start playing a more action-oriented game.
 Story mode - explore the town of Grimhaven and its surrounding areas in this story-driven game mode.
 Untimely Death - now when your character dies, you start at the beginning of the level you are actively on instead of back in town (It's a lot more forgiving).

notes.title: Update 10/21/23
notes.notes:
This update adds bug fixes and additional content.

In particular, this addresses an issue where the game would crash when the player would come into contact with certain areas. Please feel free to reach out to us regarding any issues you might encounter.  We are also excited to hear any feedback you may have too.

notes.title: Day 1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for being patient with addressing any issues you may have encountered.  This update fixes a variety of initial release bugs. There are also some corrections made to the interaction with the environment in the game.  A couple other fun features have been stuck into the game for people to find.  

The next update should be out in the next few days. This one will add more content and features. Thanks again and we hope you are enjoying the game!
